measurementNotes: Distinct ground states are sampled once per scene update before input, using the presented terrain revision and pan offset. They are not proof of physical display presentation.
Per-second distinct-update bins include pipeline startup and deliberate small-motion deadband skips near turnarounds.
Frame preparation elapsed time includes worker and main-actor scheduling/reconciliation; worker signposts measure separate stages and must not be added to inclusive CPU sample weights.
Duplicate identical os-signpost export tables are deduplicated for worker interval counts.
Simulator input/scene and CPU counts cannot verify physical-device FPS.

acceptance.nativeAC: Every measured ground-zoom second in all five final Mac captures exceeds 60 distinct scene-observed changes; minimum 79. This is not an individual-frame deadline or physical display guarantee.
acceptance.batteryLowPower: Path improves from 546 to 597 observed changes per ten seconds; strict steady 60 remains unverified.
acceptance.ipadSimulator: Diagnostics only; startup and early polygon dips remain. Physical iPad FPS unverified.
